'''Interloper Twelve''' was a [[callsign]] used by one member of [[Interloper Squadron]].

During the [[Battle of Distna]], [[Interloper Eight]] and Twelve were ordered to tractor the heavily damaged [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-Wings]]. Eight tractored [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn's]] ship but it was not known whose ship Twelve assisted.
